about: work's Go plugin (SEMWS M1): the Splitter of plugins/go/split.go, judged by its own tests (the Splitter laws on generated files and on every Go file of this repository, the key rows, the protocol).

mutants.name: m1-method-without-receiver
mutants.rule: A method is keyed with its receiver's type: two types' String methods are two units (TestKeysAreNames; TestSplitterLaws's KeysAreUnique).

mutants.name: m1-pointer-receiver-kept
mutants.rule: A pointer receiver's method is keyed by its type, as a value receiver's (TestKeysAreNames).

mutants.name: m1-line-comment-cut
mutants.from: cuts = append(cuts, cut{end: lineEnd(end), unit: u})
mutants.to: cuts = append(cuts, cut{end: end + 0*lineEnd(end), unit: u})
mutants.rule: The comment after a declaration on its line stays in its unit (TestKeysAreNames; EditStaysInItsUnit).

mutants.name: m1-twice-keyed-once
mutants.rule: A key taken twice (two init funcs) is unique as "K #2" (law KeysAreUnique, TestKeysAreNames).

mutants.name: m1-last-unit-short
mutants.rule: The units join to the whole file, its last comment included (law UnitsAreTheFile, TestSplitterLaws).

mutants.name: m1-unreadable-is-empty
mutants.rule: A file go/parser cannot read is Unreadable, never a file of no units (TestProtocol).
